title: The Best Universal Remotes
subtitle: Universal remotes and hubs that control your TV, streamer, and smart home, ranked.
intro: We pulled the universal remotes on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: a hub for hidden devices, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi control, and smart home support.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.name: SwitchBot Universal Remote with Hub Mini (Matter)
awards.why: SwitchBot's remote and Matter hub bundle, rated 4.2 stars by 5,325 buyers.

awards.label: Best for Home Assistant
awards.name: SofaBaton X2
awards.why: A touchscreen remote that can also control Home Assistant over MQTT.

awards.label: Best for Home Theater
awards.name: SofaBaton X1S
awards.why: One-touch activities across a 500,000-device code library, with Alexa and Google.

systems_note: SwitchBot remotes join Matter through the included hub. SofaBaton's X2 has a Home Assistant integration.

products.name: SwitchBot Universal Remote Control with Hub Mini Matter Enabled, Multi-use Smart Remote with Customize App, Control 25 IR/Bluetooth Devices and 10 Scenes, Compatible with TV/AC/SwitchBot BLE Devices

cons: Check IR and Bluetooth compatibility first

products.name: SwitchBot Universal Remote Control with Hub 3, Multi-use Smart Remote with Customize App, Control 25 IR/Bluetooth Devices and 10 Scenes, Compatible with TV/AC/SwitchBot BLE Devices

products.verdict: A touchscreen home theater remote that doubles as a Home Assistant controller.
cons: Voice assistants aren't named in the bullets

products.name: SofaBaton X1S Universal Remote with Hub & Customize APP
products.verdict: Starts the TV, soundbar, and streamer together with one button or one voice command.

specs.hub: X1S hub with 2 wired IR transmitters

buyers_guide.q: Why a universal remote with a hub?
buyers_guide.a: The hub controls devices hidden in a cabinet over IR, Bluetooth, and Wi-Fi, and a single button can switch on the TV, soundbar, and streamer together.

buyers_guide.q: Will it control my streaming stick?
buyers_guide.a: Bluetooth remotes and hubs can control Fire TV, Roku, and Apple TV. Check the device list in the listing.
Logitech discontinued Harmony remotes, so the picks here are from brands still making and updating them.

notes: Prices, ratings, and review counts refreshed from Amazon.
